page_note: Dense cosmological exposition of the Three Fathers and their emanations: First Father → First Power → three emanations; Second Father = Third Ambassador (Protomē) → Pillar of Glory, Jesus the Radiance, Virgin of Light; Third Father = Jesus the Radiance → Light-Nous, Great Judge, Youth. Almost entirely substrate. Single editorial seam at seg 22-23 where the Light-Nous (substratic cosmic figure) is extended into 'father of all apostles, first of ecclesiae, set before our likeness in the holy Church' — classic seam pattern: cosmic figure → ecclesial identification. The score's high apostolic_dialogue at seg 21 is misleading — ⲛⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ here functions as cosmic source-of-apostles, not the dialogue frame. Heavy lacunae in second half (48.6% damage) but recoverable structure.
